### Justification
Defect #1 is a straightforward, 100%-reproducible correctness bug in the primary form-submission path — exactly the kind of bug that should block a release candidate. Defect #2 compounds this by showing users incorrect pricing after a legitimate interaction sequence. Combined with the missing validation and missing feedback (#3, #4), this build should go back to engineering before shipping."
